title: SQL Injection: string-concatenated query
description: User input is concatenated directly into a SQL statement, allowing an attacker to alter the query.

title: Hardcoded password in source code
description: A database password is embedded in source code, where anyone with repo access can read it.

title: Use of a broken cryptographic algorithm (MD5)
description: MD5 is collision-broken and must not be used for integrity or security purposes.

title: Cross-site scripting: unencoded output
description: User-supplied search text is written to the response without HTML encoding.
